plain: Whitley Strieber, who says he has met aliens, says that in San Antonio, Texas, in 1994 or 1996, a doctor named Roger Leir tried to remove an object from his ear, a white disc, and when the doctor touched it with a probe it sank down into his earlobe, all while Anne Strieber filmed it. Strieber tells it firsthand, and Michels, who says the implant shows up on an x-ray and that he has watched the video of the thing "moving at its own," retells it as an implant that dodged the surgeon. If true, it would mean the object was able to move by itself.
